name: Ceramic Search
description: This is the plugin for Ceramic search, a high-quality web search tool for AI agents. Here is the official page for Ceramic ai: https://www.ceramic.ai/ The plugin connects to the Ceramic MCP server so that users can invoke Ceramic search while using Claude Code.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `search` (Web search for AI agents using Ceramic) and **1 MCP server**, `ceramic-search`.

Installs with `claude plugin install ceramic-search@claude-community` from `CeramicTeam/ceramic-claude-code-plugins` (`plugins/search`).

This is the plugin for Ceramic search, a high-quality web search tool for AI agents. Here is the official page for Ceramic ai: https://www.ceramic.ai/ The plugin connects to the Ceramic MCP server so that users can invoke Ceramic search while using Claude Code.
